newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank cuts refinancing offer, rate flat.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank cuts refinancing offer, rate flat.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday it cut its one-week refinancing funds on offer to 600 billion lei ($89.6 million) from 660 billion but kept flat at 226 percent the minimum permitted rate for auctioned credits.
Last week, an undersubscription for the BNR's one-week funds triggered a plunge in the average auctioned rate to 226.31 percent from a previous 426.50 percent.
Short-term money market rates were near 235 percent at Thursday's open, with traders expecting them to hold near that level.
Refinancing auction results, due later on Thursday, are displayed on FXRP.
-- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 ($ = 6700 Romanian Lei)
